svg.aria-label: The showroom's start as a component diagram
svg.text: The showroom's start, and what it is made of
COMPONENT DIAGRAM · LOUIS-AGENT.WEB · SITE / SHOWROOM / START
five demos, three with a window
one forward, the rest behind it in depth. Its Item slot, drawn for each demo:
a browser's bar, then a body. Its body slot:
and two more, one for each business
a website with its chat: one question, its answer
when a demo names no window
a button for each demo, the current one open
holds one thing: which demo is forward
leans the windows to the mouse
A box inside a box is held by it.
A slot is filled by whoever plugs in.
